retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast beach scene featuring a group of figures in dark, alternative fashion with a dominant over-the-shoulder foreground element and scratchy, hand-drawn typography.
excludeWhen: tropical or vibrant beach vacation themes

recipe.visualDefinition: A wide-angle beach photograph under bright, direct sunlight. A large, out-of-focus head and shoulder of a person occupy the left foreground, creating a voyeuristic perspective. In the middle ground, four individuals in dark alternative clothing (leather jackets, dark jeans) stand in a staggered formation on the sand. The background features a calm blue sea and a clear sky. The top right corner contains expressive, jittery hand-drawn black lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground person acts as a framing device for the distant group
Dark clothing contrasts sharply against the pale sand and bright sky
Staggered placement of figures creates depth and a sense of detachment
Hand-drawn text mirrors the raw, unpolished energy of the subjects
coreInvariants: High-contrast natural lighting with hard shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Foreground figure is extremely large and cropped on the left; background figures are small and centered to right-of-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large foreground ear and back-of-head on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large foreground head, moves across the sand to the group of four, then up to the hand-drawn text in the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive blue sky and pale sand provide significant negative space for the text and subjects.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle skin tones and small graphic details on clothing
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value and moderate saturation in the environment; low value and high contrast in the subjects.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly warm filters

letterConstructionRules: Scratchy, jittery strokes as if drawn with a felt-tip pen
Mix of uppercase and lowercase forms
Visible ink bleed or rough edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'B' and 'P' have exaggerated, shaky loops
Vertical strokes are often slightly curved or jagged

composition.relationshipToImage: floating in the negative space of the sky

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive style to maintain raw aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Alternative mechanical feel if hand-drawn is unavailable

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of a beach under bright sun. In the extreme left foreground, show the back of a person's head and ear out of focus. In the middle distance, place four people in 1980s post-punk fashion (leather jackets, black jeans) standing on the sand with hard shadows. The sky should be clear blue and the sea calm.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-drawn, scratchy black lettering in the upper right quadrant of the sky. The text should look like it was drawn with a shaky hand using a black marker, stacked in two lines.

verificationChecks: Foreground head is out of focus and frames the left side
Subjects are wearing dark, alternative clothing
Text is scratchy and hand-drawn in the top right
Shadows are hard and distinct on the sand

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the background
Specific clothing items (e.g., trench coats vs leather jackets)
mustRedesign: Avoid using existing band names or logos
Do not replicate specific facial features of the original subjects

mustAchieve: Sense of depth through foreground/background contrast

postGenerationChecks: Is the foreground head sufficiently blurred to act as a frame?
Does the text look manually drawn rather than digitally typed?
Are the shadows on the sand sharp and dark?
Is the overall mood detached and cool rather than cheerful?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Over-the-shoulder framing] + [Alternative fashion group] + [Bright beach setting with hard shadows] + [Scratchy hand-lettered overlay].
